semantics: Directed edge list for the current and proposed information architecture, authored per locale. Edges to proposed routes are planning edges only: plannedNotLive is true, the target is not activated, and no live navigation may expose a blocked proposed route. No breadcrumb, link or navigation change is emitted to the live website in MC-15.
